description: Agent Waste and Recycling Records: submit hauler permit records with the pickup log they answer to: each hauler permit record with its id, permit reference, hauler, the waste types and the areas it covers and the moments it takes effect and lapses; each pickup log entry with its id, reference, hauler, waste type, area collected and the moment picked up. The signed report gives the pickups and the permits, each pickup against a permit record of its hauler covering the waste type and the area collected, each covered pickup against the permit’s lapse date on the day collected, and each hauler in the pickup log against a permit record on file, and counts them, and names divergent hauler permit records: a pickup logged by a hauler whose permit record does not cover the waste type or the area collected, a permit date in the record already lapsed at the pickup date, and a hauler in the pickup log with no permit record on file; then a pickup dated before the permit covering it takes effect and a permit record stating no lapse date beside its hauler’s pickups, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No pickup log entries, or no permit records beside pickups that name a hauler, leaves those points unverified. Haulers match by permit reference or name, waste types and areas match by their words with plurals folded, so Yard wastes and yard waste are one type, a permit listing no types or no areas covers any, and a permit lapses after the day it states. This reads a waste hauler’s permits against its pickup log: wever_build-permit-check reads a building permit against its project record, while the hauler permit check reads whether every pickup was collected under a permit covering its waste type and area and in force on the day. Verdict waste_hauler_permit_divergent, waste_hauler_permit_partial, waste_hauler_permit_unverified or waste_hauler_permit_consistent. POST /api/waste-hauler-permit-check. Reads the waste and recycling records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it hauls no waste, operates no facility, contacts no regulator, hauler or disposal site and issues no permit or certification, which stay with the waste operation, its haulers, its facilities and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Waste and Recycling Records reads a waste operation’s own records: waste manifest records, hauler permit records, disposal and landfill records, recycling processing records, diversion and recovery records, pickup and collection log records, facility and scale records and contamination report records, each against the hauler permit, facility, receiving and disposal records, the waste types, areas and dates in the pickup log, the manifests and the dates the record states, the inbound, outbound and residue records, the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup totals, the service record, the scale tickets and dispositions, or the follow-up entries and the inspected load counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the waste stream: what the manifest shows, what the disposal record supports, what the permits cover, and whether the diversion claims and pickup logs hold up; it reads records about waste streams and the people who move them, not live environmental monitoring and not cleanup services: the Agent Energy family reads utility and generation records, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file and the Agent Aviation Records family reads an air operator’s flight and maintenance paper trail, while this family reads a waste operation’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-waste-recycling-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-waste-recycling-records/.
